justification.text: `Real.log (harmonic n)` is the genuine logarithm of the harmonic number, because harmonic n ≥ 1 > 0 for every n ≥ 1 and the statement assumes 1 < n; the argument is never non-positive, so Lean's junk value is never taken.

`1 < n` is the problem's own range, because Lagarias' criterion (as the registry's docstring records) is σ(n) ≤ H_n + e^{H_n} log H_n for all n ≥ 1 with equality only at n = 1, equivalently the strict inequality for all n > 1; the registry's own `lagarias_criterion` states the RH equivalence with `∀ n > 1` and this strict form, and the draft is its right-hand side.
